reader_summary.headline: Volcker senior fellow for international economics at the Council on Foreign Relations, a contributing columnist for The Washington Post .
reader_summary.overview: Volcker senior fellow for international economics at the Council on Foreign Relations, a contributing columnist for The Washington Post , two-time Pulitzer Prize Finalist. His most recent book, The Power Law: Venture Capital and the Making of the New Future , chronicles the history of the industry. Our conversation starts with his career as a writer and how he approaches writing books.

key_points.text: Volcker senior fellow for international economics at the Council on Foreign Relations, a contributing columnist for The Washington Post , two-time Pulitzer Prize Finalist.
His most recent book, The Power Law: Venture Capital and the Making of the New Future , chronicles the history of the industry.
We then dive into the origins of the venture industry, foundations of early-stage investing, and critical success factors.
